about: Six crewmembers lived and worked on space station Tacoma, forming relationships, experiencing love and loss, and facing crisis together.
Discover not just what happened to these people, but what makes them who they are, through your role as an interactive investigator.
In each section of the station, you are surrounded by digital representations of crewmembers following their own parallel story threads that diverge, recombine, and split off again.

Rewind, fast-forward, and move through these scenes’ chronologies as they swirl around you. Your interactive tools allow you to discover the tightly-knotted narrative from every angle, and in every detail.

A deeply-imagined speculative vision of the near future from the award-winning story team behind Gone Home and BioShock 2: Minerva’s Den. Now with over 2 hours of audio commentary from the developers!
“A story that's both gripping and emotional... The little details packed into the space station are touches of the sublime.
